schema: waypoints: [{"pair": k, "points": [[x, y_page], ...], "tol": px}]; pair k is the seam between text line k and line k+1 (0-based, 22 lines); points are a polyline in page pixels of site/img/p/diary1.jpg; on its x range the seam is forced to stay within tol (default 1) of the polyline. Author-traced data, read by build_atoms.py.
